QUOTE: "The field is still in the header, but its name is changed, so code that reaches into it by the plain name fails to compile. C has no access control, so this rename is the only barrier."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the field stays in the header, its name is mangled to `private_##member`, and plain-name access fails to compile. That is the name-breaking mechanism, not layout hiding.
